text:
- Total revenue across all products was £135,254.11 TW, representing a -15.0% WoW decline from £159,100.49 LW, though revenue increased +57.9% YoY.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS generated the highest revenue at £5,701.16 TW with a 4.2% share TW, but declined -39.9% WoW.
- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT achieved the second highest revenue of £5,084.81 TW with a 3.8% share TW and recorded the most orders at 105 TW compared to 123 LW.
- CHILLI LIGHTS ranked third with revenue of £4,960.25 TW representing a 3.7% share TW and showed strong growth of +115.0% WoW.
- DOORMAT BLACK FLOCK experienced the largest WoW increase with revenue surging +1544.7% from £33.00 LW to £542.76 TW.
- 3 HEARTS HANGING DECORATION RUSTIC saw the largest WoW decrease, declining -73.8% from £3,006.44 LW to £788.05 TW.
- JAM MAKING SET WITH JARS demonstrated the largest YoY increase with revenue growing +832.5% from £93.50 LY to current week levels.
- HAND WARMER SCOTTY DOG DESIGN recorded the largest YoY decrease, falling -76.8% from £2,126.08 LY.
